To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the incorporation of phenylmethyl silicone oil (PSO), which is a kind of silicone oil, into coatings can significantly improve the fouling-release performance of the coatings by improving the coating surface hydrophobicity, decreasing the coating elastic moduli and improving the leaching behavior.

the incorporation of high-viscosity PSOs into PDMS-based coatings can enhance the antifouiling performance by improving the coating's hydrophobicity, decreasing its elastic modulus, and increasing the release of PSO from coatings, while the leached PSO can facilitate the fouling removal of the coating.
the antifouing properties of PDMS coatings can be enhanced by incorporating PSO.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the incorporation of PSOs into fouling release coatings and the effect of the incorporation on the coating properties and antifouling behavior, which provides a new strategy for improving the antifouing performance of fouling-release coatings based on PDMs.
the fouling release performance of coatings with PSO incorporation, which can be used to guide the development and application of fouling release coating materials.
the fouling release coatings with high hydrophobicity, low elastic modulus, and high leaching of PSOs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the coatings with 10 wt% PSO exhibited the optimal antifouling property, which can be used as a reference for the preparation of antifouling coatings.
the incorporation of a high-viscosity PSOs with a high content can enhance the antifouiling performance of PDMS-based fouling release coatings.
the incorporation of high viscosity PSO can significantly improve the antifouiling performance of the coating.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the fouling release coatings with the incorporation of high-viscosity PSOs exhibited a high level of antifouling properties.
the incorporation of high-viscosity PSOs into the coatings could enhance the fouling release ability of the coatings.
fouling release coatings with high PSO content and low viscosity are promising candidates for the development of high-performance antifouling coatings.
The main takeaway from our work is that
fouling release coatings with high PSO leaching and low elastic modulus can exhibit excellent antifouling performances.
the incorporation of a high-viscosity PSOs can be used to improve the performance of PDMS-based coatings.
PSO can be used as a promising antifouling agent for fouling release coatings.
